extensionDescription.message: Browse Chrome bookmarks in a quiet, spatial Cover Flow.

mediaHint.message: Original file and HDR data are kept · Up to 512 MB · Stored only on this computer, never uploaded. Videos always loop muted.

emptyFile.message: This file is empty. Choose a photo or video.

largeFile.message: Choose a file smaller than 512 MB.

invalidFile.message: Choose an image or video file supported by Chrome.

decodeFailed.message: Chrome cannot decode this file. Try a supported image, MP4 or WebM video; HEVC/MOV support depends on your system.

decodeTimeout.message: This file took too long to decode. Try a smaller or different file.

noFrames.message: The file has no decodable image or video frames.

autoplayBlocked.message: Autoplay was blocked. Select Play video to retry.

playbackFailed.message: Video playback failed. Try another file or select Play video to retry.

playbackStopped.message: This video could not continue playing. Choose another file.

missingMedia.message: The saved background file is missing. Choose another file or restore the default.

storageOpenFailed.message: Unable to open local background storage.

storageBusy.message: Background storage is busy. Close other extension tabs and try again.

storageReadFailed.message: Unable to read the saved background.

storageSaveFailed.message: Unable to save the background. Check available disk space.

preferPreviewHint.message: Without a preview, a cover is generated from the site's name and theme color.

reduceFlipHint.message: Covers fade into place. Turns on automatically when Reduce Motion is on in your system settings.

dropMedia.message: Drag a photo or video here, or

photoBlurHint.message: Applies to photos only; videos keep their original quality.

privacyLocalBody.message: Reads Chrome bookmarks directly. No account, server or sync.

privacyNoTrackingBody.message: No usage data is collected. Recently opened bookmarks are recorded only on this computer.

privacyPreviews.message: Previews come from the websites themselves

privacyPreviewsBody.message: Covers use each site's public preview image (Open Graph). Fetching it visits that site; results are cached on this computer.

tryOtherKeywords.message: Try other keywords, or search in All Bookmarks

noRecentHint.message: Bookmarks you open will appear here

bookmarksFailedHint.message: Make sure bookmark access is allowed, then try again.
